items.title: US orders departure of some embassy staff and families from Saudi Arabia amid Houthi threat
items.brief: The US State Department ordered the departure of non-essential staff and family members at its embassy in Riyadh, a move that comes amid intensifying strikes on Saudi Arabia by the Iran allied Houthi rebels in Yemen.

items.title: El-Sayed’s loyalty to America, Rogers’ loyalty to Trump and other takeaways from Michigan Senate debate
items.brief: The Michigan Senate debate between Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed and Republican Mike Rogers was bitterly personal and ferociously contested — as befits a contest that could decide the chamber’s majority.

items.title: Subtropical Storm Josephine forms off Mid-Atlantic coast
items.brief: Subtropical Storm Josephine just formed off the coast of the Mid-Atlantic, but will largely be a mere nuisance for coastal areas as it moves north.

items.title: With Trump polling at new lows, FCC chair issues warning about ‘fake polls’
items.brief: With numerous reputable polls showing Democrats poised to make big gains in the midterm elections, the Republican chair of the FCC is advising local broadcasters to beware of “fake polls,” without specifying which…

items.title: Midterms and Iran: Congress could change hands, but Trump would still control the war
New Mexico attorney general files civil lawsuit against two Epstein advisers
items.brief: New Mexico Attorney General Raúl Torrez on Wednesday filed a civil lawsuit against two of Jeffrey Epstein’s closest advisers, accusing them of having “facilitated and concealed” Epstein’s crimes.

items.title: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion in New Mexico case over Cambridge Analytica scandal
items.brief: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion after the company was found to have misled users about its privacy practices in a case related to the Cambridge Analytica scandal .

items.title: The increasingly brazen alleged corruption within the Trump administration
items.brief: There is increasing evidence that voters are concerned about corruption ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.
